summary: The AgroPastoralSync Tracker is a website that helps farmers manage farms, crops and animals in one place. It shows farms information, animal numbers and farming activities. Farmers can add new records, check-up dates and see if information has been saved. They can also download records as Comma Separated Values(CSV) files. The system makes it easier for farmers to share information, communicate and manage their farming activities.
